verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a self-hosted chat platform, but the evidence pack never documents a chat or data export feature, any open export format, or a migration path. Self-hosting, offline operation and API keys (open-webui-docs-2) are at most building blocks or adjacent features, so they earn no credit. The license-change discussion is about leaving the software, not about exporting user data, so it is not relevant here.
